subject: Request to consolidate two briefing windows into one 45-minute CIO slot
messages:
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Diane Patel <diane.patel@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-10T09:06:00-04:00
Subject: Request to consolidate two briefing windows into one 45-minute CIO slot

Hi Diane,

Hope you’re well. We noticed that ClearWave currently has two adjacent holds on your CIO’s calendar next week: a 30-min technical briefing and a separate 30-min executive briefing. To make the most of everyone’s time, would your CIO be open to consolidating those into a single 45-minute slot (30-min demo + 15-min exec Q&A)?

Proposed windows (ET):
- Tue 21 May — 10:00–10:45
- Wed 22 May — 14:00–14:45
- Thu 23 May — 09:00–09:45

If none of those work, we can keep the two separate holds, but we find a single consolidated slot helps keep the execs engaged without repetition. I attached a short agenda (demo-agenda-v2.pdf) that maps the 45-minute format.

Quick asks:
- Can you confirm whether the CIO prefers a single block or two separate sessions?
- If single block, which of the three windows is best?

Thanks — happy to flex.

Sofia
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
sofia.ivanova@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0148

Attachment: demo-agenda-v2.pdf (PDF, 1 page)
From: Diane Patel <diane.patel@clearwave.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia.ivanova@redwood.com>
Date: 2029-05-10T09:42:00-04:00
Subject: Re: Request to consolidate two briefing windows into one 45-minute CIO slot

Sofia —

Thanks for the note. The CIO is open to a single block, but he’s only available at 10:00 ET on Tue 21 May. Also, could you include Nate (his chief of staff) on the invite so he can handle logistics?

If we go with 45 minutes, we’ll need a clear 10-minute segment for strategic Q&A at the end (CIO prefers high-level questions only).

— Diane
Diane Patel
VP, Enterprise Strategy, ClearWave Technologies
diane.patel@clearwave.com

Perfect — thanks for confirming, Diane. Sofia, I’ll take lead on sending the calendar merge/updated invite once you confirm the agenda tweak (10-minute strategic Q&A at end).

Two operational notes:
- We currently have two holds on ClearWave’s side: 10:00–10:30 (technical) and 10:30–11:00 (exec). Consolidating to 10:00–10:45 ET will nudge their calendar but removes the handoff overhead.
- Aditya — can you prepare a 3-slide executive summary the CIO can scan in the first 5 minutes? Keep it outcome-focused (cost, latency improvements, deployment options).

I attached the agenda with explicit timeboxes. If Sofia confirms, I’ll send the merged ICS and add Nate to the invite.

Marissa Cole

Confirming the 45-minute consolidated slot on Tue 21 May, 10:00–10:45 ET. I’ve updated the agenda to reserve the last 10 minutes for strategic Q&A and added a 3-slide executive summary at the top (Aditya will own that).

Marissa — please send the merged calendar invite (ICS) and add Nate. Diane / Nate — if you can accept the invite, we’ll treat this as the canonical session and cancel the second hold.

Quick logistics:
- Demo run-through (SRE/infra): 10:00–10:25
- Product highlights + deployment options: 10:25–10:35
- Exec Q&A (10 mins): 10:35–10:45
